results.reason: The deliverable correctly identifies the change of control termination right in Clause 14.2 (and 4.3), notes the contradictory disclosure in Clause 3.1, and recommends obtaining Pemberton's consent/waiver before closing.

The deliverable identifies that only 2 directors attended the board meeting while Article 5.1 (also noting Article 11) requires a quorum of 3, concludes the approval may be invalid, and recommends convening a new properly constituted board meeting.

The deliverable correctly states the long-stop period is 150 days, identifies the date as 16 July 2026, and calculates 133 days remaining from the deliverable date of 5 March 2026.
